panels.visual: The small temple of Athena Nike on its high bastion on the right of the steps up the Acropolis, bright sun, Glauka on the roof
panels.caption: On your right as you climb stands a small temple on a high bastion. Built around 420 BC.

panels.visual: The goddess Nike with big feathered wings flying from one champion to the next, laurel wreath in hand
panels.caption: Nike, goddess of victory, normally has wings. Wings let her fly from one winner to the next.

panels.visual: The wingless statue of Athena Nike on the bastion, athletic, calm, held on the spot by a chain of laurel
panels.caption: In Athens she was shown without wings.

panels.visual: Spartan soldiers marching into a defeated Athens while a tiny Nike flies away over the horizon
panels.caption: Athens lost the war with Sparta anyway. Victory did fly away in the end.
